entities.name: Sidelink UE Information Reporting Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where a UE informs the network about its sidelink communication interests, resource requests, QoS parameters, failures, capabilities, DRX configurations, and relay operation parameters.

entities.name: SidelinkUEInformationNR
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE to network to report sidelink communication information including interests, resource requests, QoS parameters, failures, capabilities, and DRX configurations.

entities.name: Sidelink Interest Status
entities.description: Indicates whether UE is interested or no longer interested to receive or transmit NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: Transmission Resource Request
entities.description: Requests assignment or release of transmission resources for NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: QoS Parameters and Profiles
entities.description: Reports QoS parameters and QoS profile(s) related to NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: Sidelink Failure Report
entities.description: Reports sidelink radio link failure or sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure detection.

entities.name: Peer UE Capability Information
entities.description: Reports sidelink UE capability information of associated peer UE for unicast communication.

entities.name: RLC Mode Information
entities.description: Reports RLC mode information of sidelink data radio bearer(s) received from associated peer UE for unicast communication.

entities.name: Sidelink DRX Configuration
entities.description: Reports sidelink DRX configuration received from associated peer UE for NR sidelink unicast communication.

entities.name: Sidelink DRX Assistance Information
entities.description: Reports sidelink DRX assistance information received from associated peer UE for NR sidelink unicast communication.

entities.name: DRX Configuration Reject Information
entities.description: Reports DRX configuration reject information from associated peer RX UE when UE is TX UE performing sidelink operation with resource allocation mode 1.

entities.name: U2N Relay Operation Parameters
entities.description: Reports parameters related to U2N relay operation.

relations.description: The sidelink information reporting procedure involves sending the SidelinkUEInformationNR message.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains sidelink interest status information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains transmission resource request information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains QoS parameters and profiles information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains sidelink failure report information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains peer UE capability information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains RLC mode information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains sidelink DRX configuration information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains sidelink DRX assistance information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains DRX configuration reject information element.
SidelinkUEInformationNR message contains U2N relay operation parameters information element.
